'''December 2000 Montpellier tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Royaume du Griffon (Griffon's shop), Montpellier, France on 17 December 2000. [[Matthieu Paccou]] won it. It is known from Jean Philippe Thevier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1561">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-19-monpellier-france-17-12-2000d1561/ monpellier-france-17-12-2000], DeckTech (Jean Philippe "Warrior" Thevier, 19 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-19-monpellier-france-17-12-2000d1561/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Royaume du Griffon (Griffon's shop), Montpellier, France
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Matthieu Paccou]]
